tagline: Community bank providing diversified financial services across the Carolinas with strong asset quality and capital position
hero_kpi_rationale: ROAA is the key profitability KPI for banks, measuring the efficiency of asset deployment. Premier Bancorp improved its ROAA to 0.89% in 2025 from 0.63% in 2024, reflecting better operational management despite impacts from securities losses and Hurricane Helene provisions.

risks.title: Economic risk
risks.score_rationale: First Bancorp is exposed to economic fluctuations, including interest rate changes and recessions, which may impact its operations in the Carolinas and interest margin performance.

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: First Bancorp is exposed to credit risk from its customer base, with provisions related to Hurricane Helene and stable asset quality at 0.30% NPA ratio.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate changes directly impact NIM and net interest income, a key component of the bank's business model.

risks.title: Liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: First Bancorp maintains strong capital ratios (CET1 14.10%), reducing liquidity risk, although depositor confidence loss remains a structural threat.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk
risks.score_rationale: As a bank, First Bancorp is exposed to hacking threats and sensitive data theft that could impact its customers and reputation.

risks.title: Reputation risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputation risk is limited, with a solid footprint in the Carolinas and no major scandals identified in the documents.
